item.title: Cars jumping red lights, driving on green pedestrian light, 25th August
item.description:
Cars continuously jump the red light at this junction, making it incredibly dangerous for pedestrians. Just this morning I was waiting for a green light to cross. The light and sound had been on for at least a second when a car drove through. Thankfully I have good eyesight and was able to see the car coming. A poor sighted pedestrian would most likely have been run over. Please install cameras or do something to stop this before there is a serious accident.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Suffolk Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
